title: Compose Kit Overwrites Mcp Kit Data With Empty Derived State
description: Fix ComposeKit useEffect that called setResolvedData(derivedData) when kit is undefined, wiping data={payload.kitArtifacts} from McpKitViewer/McpDesignViewer so UI showed 0 designs/types/ports.
summary: ComposeKit effect no longer calls setResolvedData(derivedData) when the `data` prop is set. Previously, MCP viewers passed only data={payload.kitArtifacts} without kit/onDataChange; useInteractiveControllableValue treated that as uncontrolled while derivedData was {} from buildKitDataFromKit(undefined), so the effect wiped real kit artifact data and the UI showed 0 designs/types/ports and no metadata. Rebuilt compose/engine dist/mcp-app.html; compose/ui vitest 134 passed.
